# fx-991CE X emulator

Source: https://github.com/magicnothief/fx991ex-emulator, commit 2c26421 (version 1.2.2).
The upstream package.json declares MIT; upstream did not include a separate LICENSE file at this revision. The upstream README and package manifest are included here. The only local code change redirects the decimal.js import to the adjacent vendored copy.

The upstream project says some display glyphs are derived from Casio user-guide screenshots; upstream describes the emulator as a clean-room reimplementation and not affiliated with Casio. Rights to the underlying guide-derived assets have not been independently established. The device simulated is the fx-991CE X, with known differences from fx-991EX and fx-991ES PLUS.

decimal.js is distributed under the MIT licence; its licence is in decimal/LICENCE.md.
